statement.zh: 叙利亚莱兰 1985 年发掘季记录了建筑与出土，见 Weiss 等 1990（AJA 94/4）。干旱崩溃模型留假说栏。
statement.en: At Tell Leilan (Syria), the 1985 excavation season recorded architecture and finds, as documented in Weiss et al. 1990 (AJA 94/4). Drought-collapse models stay in the hypothesis column.
